name: Work
description: Work requests, task assignments, deliverables, project updates, and code or report reviews from colleagues, managers or clients.

name: Meetings
description: Meeting invitations, rescheduling, availability requests, and coordination of calls, appointments and get-togethers with colleagues or vendors.

name: School
description: Classes, assignments, exams, deadlines, grades, enrollment and messages from instructors, classmates or the school office.

name: Job Search
description: Job applications, interview invitations, recruiter messages, assessments, job offers, requirements and job alerts.

name: Finance and Billing
description: Bills, invoices, payments, receipts, refunds, subscriptions and expense reports.

name: Promotions and Newsletters
description: Marketing offers, sales, discounts, abandoned carts, newsletters, webinars and referral programs from companies.

name: Alerts and Notifications
description: Automated notifications: security sign-in alerts, delivery updates, system and server alerts, storage and account notices.

name: Personal
description: Messages from family and friends: invitations, plans, photos, reunions and casual conversation.
